items.label: OT example: regular rate
items.source: docket-1099 s.3: 45 hours at $15 plus $450 commission in the week; regular rate = total straight-time pay / hours (29 CFR 778.117)

items.label: OT example: overtime premium
items.source: 0.5 x regular rate x hours over 40, same week

items.label: OT example: total weekly pay
items.source: Straight-time pay plus commission plus overtime premium, same week
